calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when recent 20-day realized volatility is compressed relative to its 60-day baseline; capped at +/-5 before ranking. Uses only completed historical closes.

validation.regime_notes: The 20/60-day warmup yields valid observations only in the recent aligned sample (165 daily cross-sectional dates, 15-asset universe). IC/ICIR uncertainty is therefore material despite broad cross-sectional coverage on valid dates.
